criteria.text: Treatment of acute attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE); approval criterion 5 is covered by this closed indication.
Patient is 12 years of age or older (FDA labeled age; approval criterion 1).
Prescribed by or in consultation with an immunologist (approval criterion 2).
Patient has a confirmed diagnosis of hereditary angioedema (approval criterion 3).
Medications with an established link to angioedema (e.g. ACE inhibitors, estrogen replacement therapy) have been evaluated and discontinued where appropriate (approval criterion 4).
Not taking in combination with another treatment indicated for acute HAE attacks (denial criterion 2).
No severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class C; denial criterion 3).

notes: Partial encoding from AK Ekterly (sebetralstat), a plasma kallikrein inhibitor, Criteria Version 1: Original 08/15/2025; Accepted 9/19/2025; Effective 11/1/2025. The effective_date remains 2025-11-01.

Encoded: FDA labeled age 12 years or older, prescribed by or in consultation with an immunologist only, confirmed HAE diagnosis, and angioedema-linked medications evaluated and discontinued where appropriate. Approval criterion 5 is encoded via the closed acute-attack indication; no separate acute-only attestation is required. Denial criteria 2 and 3 are approval-blocking predicates; denial criterion 1 is failure to meet approval criteria.
Duration notes only: initial approval up to 3 months; reauthorization approval up to 1 year.
Cautions (notes only): Ekterly should not be used with moderate or strong CYP3A4 inducers or strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Dose adjustment may be required with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors.
Dose adjustment may be necessary in moderate hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh Class B). Safety in pregnancy or breastfeeding has not been determined.
Quantity limits, dosing adjustments, cautions, and approval durations require attestation/manual review and are not numeric predicates; this pack remains partial.
PDL context: Ekterly is non-preferred in HAE TREATMENTS. Berinert and Firazyr remain text_only, so no evaluate-linked alternatives are specified.
